commits.message:
Refactor OfflineImageCache: Simplify metadata handling, remove RAM cache, and streamline download logic

- Removed unnecessary RAM cache and related methods to simplify memory management.
- Streamlined metadata loading and saving processes for better performance.
- Consolidated image download logic to reduce redundancy and improve clarity.
- Enhanced error handling during image downloads and cache management.
- Updated image retrieval methods to directly use cached data or download as needed.
commits.author: SanoBld

commits.message:
Enhance image sizing and offline caching mechanisms

- Improved image URL resizing logic to ensure correct sizes are requested from various sources, including Deezer, Wikimedia, and YouTube.
- Added a helper function to pick appropriate sizes based on target dimensions.
- Implemented a mechanism to handle failed image loads by falling back to original URLs.
- Introduced parallel download limits to prevent excessive socket usage during background downloads.
- Enhanced image validation to ensure only valid image bytes are cached.
- Updated the offline image cache to handle errors more gracefully and retry with original URLs when resized images fail to load.
